title: D2 keycustodian error codes spec
description: Domain-specialized copy of contracts/error-codes/error-codes.canonical.schema.json, narrowed to the keycustodian catalog: the KEYCUSTODIAN_* code-prefix regex, the [400] httpStatus subset, and the single validation_failure category. Conforms to the canonical 7-field set (including factoryShape) but tightens the value constraints so editors catch a non-KEYCUSTODIAN_ code, a non-400 status, or a non-validation category at edit time. This is the source-of-truth catalog that D2.Edge.KeyCustodian.ErrorCodes.SourceGen reads to emit KeyCustodianErrorCodes.g.cs + KeyCustodianFailures.g.cs into D2.Edge.KeyCustodian.Domain. A drift-guard test asserts this copy stays field-aligned with the canonical schema.

code.description: Wire-format error code (SCREAMING_SNAKE, KEYCUSTODIAN_*-prefixed). Must be unique across the spec.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status mapping. Drives both transport-side response shape AND gRPC StatusCode mapping at the transport binding (400 -> InvalidArgument). In the unified generator it selects the base D2Result delegation factory (400 -> ValidationFailed). Expanding the matrix requires updating the codegen mapping (D2KEC005 fires on unknown values).

category.description: Closed semantic/telemetry classification. NOT the factory selector — httpStatus drives factory selection. Added to the wire (gRPC trailers + JSON envelope) so consumers can do generic class-based handling without importing the producer's catalog.

userMessageKey.description: Translation key reference rendered as the messages argument on the emitted D2Result factory (e.g. TK.Keycustodian.Validation.SOAK_NOT_ELAPSED). The generator enforces existence by inverse-transforming the symbol path to the snake_case key (TK.Keycustodian.Validation.SOAK_NOT_ELAPSED -> keycustodian_validation_SOAK_NOT_ELAPSED) and asserting membership in contracts/messages/en-US.json (D2ERC002). Coarse on purpose - one key per status bucket so the user-facing surface does not leak which validation step failed.

factoryName.description: PascalCase symbol for the emitted factory method (e.g. KidInvalid, SoakNotElapsed). Must be unique across the spec.

factoryShape.description: Closed enum that drives the generated factory's signature variant — must cover every current D2Result factory variant so regeneration is byte-identical. standard: (messages?, traceId?). with_error_code: (messages?, errorCode?, traceId?) — used by ValidationFailed on the delegating per-domain path; the errorCode override is how domain factories stamp a specific code on a base status. validation: (messages?, inputErrors?, errorCode?, traceId?). none: no factory generated for this code. Every keycustodian entry is with_error_code (the delegating emitter implements with_error_code + none; a 400 with_error_code entry delegates to D2Result.ValidationFailed).

doc.description: XML <summary> text rendered on the emitted constant + factory.
